taskReconciliation.task: DeployableFlare, GravTrap, GravityTetherTool, and scanner pulse paths audited; hot auxiliary lifecycle moved out of per-object scripts.
Facades no longer own Light, ParticleSystem, Rigidbody, Collider broadphase, SpringJoint, or local pulse drawer effects.
Auxiliary DTOs and job payloads use raw public fields and explicit layout; scanner pulse properties removed.
Primary DTOs/signals are explicit 16/32/64 byte layouts; editor ABI validator added.
GenerateMockAuxiliaryDeploymentsJob writes 500 deterministic records and now schedules behind the router pending fence without Tick-time force completion.
UpdateDeployedAuxiliaryJob owns lifetime countdown and route emission in NativeArray.
AuxiliaryFlareLightSignal replaces Unity Light ownership.
AuxiliarySonarRequestSignal replaces scanner-local pulse drawer and collider pulse; ScannerTool routes effectiveScanRadius into the router.
AuxiliaryTetherConnectionSignal replaces Unity joint and force-loop ownership; each tether slot now owns its own anchor AUP.
GlobalQualityWeight drives continuous 15Hz to 60Hz cadence and ping expansion curve.
Signals carry double3 AUP; VFX staging downcasts only after camera-AUP subtraction.

StageAuxiliaryVFXJob writes Vault matrix payloads and post-fence upload publishes double-buffered GraphicsBuffer pages for downstream visual sync; unchanged snapshots skip upload through count/hash/camera/quality dirty-gate.
Jobs use deterministic Burst float mode and deterministic AUP/frame hash seeding.
Large Vault arrays use UninitializedMemory with initialized-bound guards.
300-frame telemetry ring and Dump_SHINOBU_229.bin path implemented; CpuMicroseconds is schedule-to-finalize wall time until Unity profiler proof supplies exact Burst kernel timing.
UI Toolkit X-Ray window reads telemetry and writes tuning through router API.
ReadOnlySpan byte parser is called during cold boot, writes Vault profiles, applies tuning, and falls back to deterministic unmanaged profiles.
Editor-only AUP-subtract gizmo added without scene marker GameObjects.
Auxiliary OOP scanner writes shared report and flags cross-domain TetherManager residue.

Static audit and docs are written; Directory.Build.targets shields the known stale generated-project entry, but compile/profiler proof has not rerun because CPU guard remains saturated and unrelated sibling-agent missing symbols may remain.

struct.name: DeployedAuxiliaryDTO
struct.math: 24 + 4 + 4 + 32 = 64 bytes; one L1 cache line, 8-byte aligned double3 first.

struct.name: AuxiliaryTetherAnchorDTO
struct.math: 24 + 4 + 4 = 32 bytes; per-slot tether anchor does not disturb the 64-byte deployment ABI.

struct.name: AuxiliaryTelemetryEntry
struct.math: 14 scalar 4-byte fields plus one 8-byte reserved field = 56 + 8 = 64 bytes; telemetry occupies one cache line.

scalabilityCurve.low: ResolveCadenceHz collapses work toward 15Hz; sensor ping rate lerps toward lifetime-rate 0.65 and emits fewer frames; flare route lowers range multiplier; no binary low-end branch.
scalabilityCurve.middle: Cadence, ping expansion, and route density rise smoothly through math.smoothstep/math.lerp while using the same DTOs and SignalBus lanes.
scalabilityCurve.high: Cadence reaches 60Hz; downstream light/sonar/tether consumers receive dense data for visual overkill without changing simulation ownership.

pointerAliasingAndDependencyGraph.vaultLockFence: All NativeArrays used by scheduled lifecycle/VFX jobs and post-fence telemetry proof writes are locked before scheduling/finalization, re-resolved under the lock, and unlocked only after pending job finalization plus telemetry recording.
pointerAliasingAndDependencyGraph.tuningLockFence: TryWriteTuning locks ShinobuAuxiliaryTuning, resolves only the tuning handle, writes one DTO, and unlocks immediately; scheduled jobs receive tuning by value.
pointerAliasingAndDependencyGraph.fence: Router schedules work and finalizes through DispatcherJobFence.TryFinalizeCompleted/TryComplete; it does not complete in the middle of simulation Tick. Force-complete is restricted to teardown.

compileGuard.asmdef: No new sibling Runtime asmdef reference was introduced. Auxiliary files live under the root Hecton8.Core asmdef path and communicate outward through SignalBus payloads and Vault buffers.
compileGuard.build: CPU guard cleared once earlier; dotnet build failed because generated Hecton8.Core.csproj did not include new auxiliary files and the repo had unrelated missing sibling-agent symbols. Directory.Build.targets now shields the known SHINOBU_229 stale generated-project entry, but rebuild/profiler proof has not rerun because CPU guard is saturated. Generated csproj files were not edited as source.
compileGuard.directoryBuildTargetsShield: Directory.Build.targets prunes the deleted HectonScannerProjectionState.cs compile item and conditionally includes SHINOBU_229 runtime/editor auxiliary source files without editing generated csproj files.

authorityRouteCard.reason: Route card has owner, instruments, phases, cadence, capacity, failure mode, telemetry, shutdown, and proof plan. Runtime-facing route cannot be GREEN without Unity import, Console, Play Mode, profiler/GC, and signal stress artifacts.

first20MinutesRouteImpact.routeImpact: Flare darkness response, scanner active pulse feedback, and gravity tether support now route as deterministic Vault/SignalBus data instead of Unity-object effect owners. This supports the scanner P1 extension and hazard/tool proof, but it is not end-to-end playable route proof.
first20MinutesRouteImpact.proofRequired: Unity import and clean Console for SHINOBU_229 files; Play Mode deploy smoke for flare, sensor ping, and gravity tether; Profiler or GCMonitor 0 B/frame capture; SignalBus telemetry under mock stress; Frame Debugger proof for the double-buffered VFX upload.
first20MinutesRouteImpact.parkedWorkRejected: Scanner lore/UI zero-GC rewrite, downstream audio/AI/cockpit radar consumer migration, tether-manager cold pool removal, Data Monolith h8bin migration, and downstream visual implementation remain owner-specific work outside this route.

accessorPurity.readApis: TryReadTelemetry, TryReadDeployments, TryReadTuning, and TryWriteTuning use existing Vault generation handles only. TryReadDeployments returns NativeArray<DeployedAuxiliaryDTO>.ReadOnly and fails closed while the lifecycle job is active.
accessorPurity.hotPaths: Tick, deploy, cancel, and telemetry finalization use existing handles only, lock runtime buffers before re-resolving job-visible views, and fail closed when boot handles are absent.

safetyMetadata.job: Index 0 writes the initialized bound; writable metadata matches actual access.
safetyMetadata.pass: Consumer only; writes telemetry ring, not the bound. It is a direct post-fence pass without Burst/NoAlias claims, avoiding a tiny-job schedule/readback loop.
safetyMetadata.vaultLockFence: ShinobuAuxiliaryActiveCount, ShinobuAuxiliaryTetherAnchors, ShinobuAuxiliaryTelemetryRing, and ShinobuAuxiliaryTelemetryCursor are locked/unlocked with the runtime buffers; job-visible views and post-fence proof buffers are re-resolved under the lock.
safetyMetadata.vaultShutdown: ShinobuAuxiliaryActiveEquipmentState stores AuxiliaryActiveEquipmentDTO and releases through ReleaseHandle with the rest of the auxiliary generation handles.

domainIsolation.auxiliaryToolsDependency: Auxiliary runtime/jobs no longer import Hecton8.Tools or reuse ActiveEquipmentDTO/ActiveEquipmentStateFlags from a sibling tool domain; the mirror is a local unmanaged AuxiliaryActiveEquipmentDTO.
domainIsolation.worldDependency: Router runtime AUP conversion uses HectonFloatingOrigin.CurrentTotalOffsetDouble directly and no longer imports Hecton8.World.
domainIsolation.mockCompletion: GenerateMockDeployments schedules mock and VFX jobs asynchronously and waits for LateFrame finalization; no DispatcherJobFence.TryComplete call remains outside teardown.
domainIsolation.readPurity: GravTrap.IsActive reads router state directly and no longer has an _activationIssued mirror. DeployableFlare.State, IsBurning, and RemainingFuel read router lifetime directly and no longer have _fuelTimer or _state mirrors. Scanner quality tier methods that mutate cached state were renamed from Resolve* to Refresh*.
domainIsolation.facadeReadback: DeployableFlare.ResolveState returns Burning only while a central router record exists; otherwise it returns Extinguished without keeping a local countdown or enum-state mirror.

staticVerification.promptExtraction: Exact SHINOBU_229 XML prompt re-extracted from Docs/Tasks/CURRENT_BATCH.md after hardening; task count remains 20.
staticVerification.runtimeForbiddenPatterns: Touched runtime/facade/projection files contain no ScannerPulseDrawer, scanner pulse shadow state, Unity Light/Joint/ParticleSystem/OverlapSphere, UnityEngine.Random, Time.deltaTime, Time.fixedDeltaTime, projection Time.time residues, active-pulse interpolated Debug.Log, string.Format, LINQ, or foreach residues. Remaining forbidden-pattern matches are editor-only literal strings in Auxiliary_OOP_Scanner.
staticVerification.compileWall: Hecton8.Core.csproj still contains stale generated metadata on disk, but Directory.Build.targets now prunes the deleted scanner projection state and conditionally includes SHINOBU_229 source files. No dotnet build was relaunched; sibling dependency and runtime profiler proof remain pending.
staticVerification.reportParse: This XML self-audit parses as XML and EQUIPMENT_OPTIMIZATION_REPORT.json parses as JSON.
staticVerification.assetMeta: No orphan .cs.meta or .shader.meta files were found under Assets/_Project after deleting HectonScannerProjectionState.cs/.meta.

csvProfileIntegration.coldBoot: TryLoadProfilesCold reads into ShinobuAuxiliaryCsvScratch, parses ReadOnlySpan bytes, writes ShinobuAuxiliaryProfiles, and applies profiles to AuxiliaryTuningDTO.
csvProfileIntegration.fallback: Missing CSV seeds deterministic unmanaged fallback profiles for flare, sensor ping, and gravity tether.
csvProfileIntegration.dataMonolith: The CSV is the XML-mandated cold tuning bridge and static fallback. It is not Data Monolith runtime readiness; Assets/StreamingAssets/Hecton8/DataMonolith/static_data.h8bin is absent in this workspace.

nanVaccination.producerSignalFiniteGuard: UpdateDeployedAuxiliaryJob sanitizes route scalars before NativeQueue ParallelWriter enqueue because managed SignalBus.TryPush guards are not executed by Burst producers; jobs open the first-party lanes through OpenParallelWriter.
nanVaccination.lifetimeRadiusGuard: Deploy and cancel/readback paths reject non-finite AUP, sanitize authored lifetime and radius, and reset non-finite accumulated tick debt before integration.
nanVaccination.gravityTetherAnchorGuard: TryDeployGravityTetherAup rejects non-finite projectile/anchor AUP; RouteGravityTether drops non-finite anchor/distance and clamps rest length to sanitized TetherMaxDistance with NonFiniteRecovered telemetry.

signalRouteAccounting.prewarm: Auxiliary flare, sonar, and tether lanes prewarm the full one-signal-per-active-slot producer ceiling, avoiding NativeQueue growth when 1024 active deployments route in one frame.
signalRouteAccounting.lowTierFlushCaps: Low-tier SignalBus flush caps shed optional visual/effect bandwidth under low GlobalQualityWeight while deployment lifetime truth remains in Vault; dropped/coalesced/peak pressure is recorded in AuxiliaryTelemetryEntry.
signalRouteAccounting.routeCounters: AuxiliaryRouteCounterDTO counts successful Burst-side route construction and NativeQueue enqueue attempts. It is not claimed as a guaranteed consumer-delivery counter.
signalRouteAccounting.deliveryTelemetry: AuxiliaryTelemetryEntry records SignalBus last-flush lane drops, corruptions, and peak queued signal pressure so overflow/backpressure is visible in the 300-frame ring.

gpuUploadDiscipline.doubleBuffer: Auxiliary VFX presentation uses GraphicsBuffer A/B pages plus an immutable read-buffer pointer.
gpuUploadDiscipline.writePath: AuxiliaryEquipmentRouterRuntime creates buffers through GraphicsBufferUploadUtility.CreateStructuredLockBuffer and uploads via GraphicsBufferUploadUtility.UploadNativeArray, whose implementation maps LockBufferForWrite and copies with UnsafeMemoryCopyGuard.TryMemCpy before UnlockBufferAfterWrite.
gpuUploadDiscipline.setDataInAuxiliaryRoute: No Auxiliary-owned VFX upload path calls GraphicsBuffer.SetData or GraphicsBufferUploadUtility.UploadArraySetData.
gpuUploadDiscipline.dirtyGate: Unchanged active count, deployment snapshot hash, camera AUP, and quality weight skip UploadNativeArray and keep the previous read buffer.

radarBoundary.owned: ScannerTool active sensor ping lifetime routes through AuxiliaryEquipmentRouterRuntime.TryDeploySensorPing and AuxiliarySonarRequestSignal.
radarBoundary.projectionConsumer: HectonScannerProjectionFeature reads SignalBus<AuxiliarySonarRequestSignal>.GetSignals(), subtracts HectonFloatingOrigin.CurrentTotalOffsetDouble from the double3 AUP before float downcast, and derives presentation age from CurrentRadius / MaxRadius in the latest signal snapshot. It no longer uses Time.time, StartTime, or a managed projection-state mirror.
radarBoundary.directPublish: ScannerTool no longer calls HectonScannerProjectionState.Publish, and the unused HectonScannerProjectionState static shadow-state file plus meta were deleted. Scanner projection is now derived from AuxiliarySonarRequestSignal snapshots.
radarBoundary.activeAudio: ScannerTool active pulse no longer calls IAudioService.PlayAtPoint and no longer gates the acoustic signal on AudioClip assets. It publishes AcousticPingSignal through SignalBus with active-sonar channel flags and AUP payload.
radarBoundary.activeStatusSignal: ScannerToolActiveSignal producer no longer calls GlobalSignals.Publish; ScannerTool pushes directly to SignalBus<ScannerToolActiveSignal> from registered LateFrameTick. Downstream GlobalSignals.TryGetLatestScannerToolActiveSignal fallback readers remain legacy consumer bridge debt outside this auxiliary producer route.
radarBoundary.activePulseDebug: ScannerTool.LogScanPulse no longer builds an interpolated Debug.Log string in editor/development builds; the method is intentionally blank to preserve zero-GC active pulse proof.
radarBoundary.notOwned: Visor/SpectrumSystem sonar visuals, audio sonar, cockpit radar UI, and AI sensory sonar consume or present signals and remain outside SHINOBU_229 write authority.
radarBoundary.scannerResiduals: Scanner scientific/lore discovery still has managed string construction, ScanEvents remains scanner-log/progression legacy routing, broad scanner knowledge/UI coupling remains in ScannerTool, and downstream latest-signal fallback readers remain consumer bridge debt. Those are scanner knowledge/UI routes, not the auxiliary light/physics/VFX effect route owned by SHINOBU_229.
